title: DistilledBehaviorPolicyV1
description: Distilled policy artifact schema. Closed: oneOf separates CONTRACT_TARGET_NOT_TRAINED (no fake pins/metrics/weights) from TRAINED_ARTIFACT (seven hash pins incl artifactSchemaHash, normalization, linear weights, training metrics with array fixture families). The two branches are absolutely mutually exclusive: CONTRACT_TARGET_NOT_TRAINED requires trainingStatus and forbids artifactId/artifactHashes/normalization/linear/training (metrics)/acceptance/determinism/closure; TRAINED_ARTIFACT forbids trainingStatus (not.required) and requires status != CONTRACT_TARGET_NOT_TRAINED plus every artifact pin. In the not-trained branch, gates/modelKind (if present) are target threshold / target model-kind declarations only, never an artifact. artifactSchemaHash must equal the artifactSchema.hash pinned in DistilledBehaviorPolicyV1.json (enforced by harness; the schema itself never pins the contract, avoiding a cycle); modelKind enum with no fake pass for SHALLOW_GBDT_V1; means/scales/coefficients are explicit property whitelists; additionalProperties false everywhere. All numbers must be finite (JSON schema plus runtime validator).

modelKind.description: In TRAINED_ARTIFACT this is the artifact model kind. In CONTRACT_TARGET_NOT_TRAINED (if present) it is only a target model-kind declaration, never an artifact and never an acceptance claim.

gates.description: Target declaration shape for CONTRACT_TARGET_NOT_TRAINED documents, or artifact threshold shape for TRAINED_ARTIFACT documents. In CONTRACT_TARGET_NOT_TRAINED this is a target declaration, not an artifact; gates never imply metrics, acceptance or registration.

oneOf.title: CONTRACT_TARGET_NOT_TRAINED
oneOf.description: Absolute mutual exclusion with TRAINED_ARTIFACT: this branch requires trainingStatus and forbids every trained-artifact field (artifactId/artifactHashes/normalization/linear/training(metrics)/acceptance/determinism/closure). gates/modelKind are allowed only as target threshold / target model-kind declarations, never as artifact fields, and never imply acceptance.

oneOf.title: TRAINED_ARTIFACT
oneOf.description: A real trained artifact: status != CONTRACT_TARGET_NOT_TRAINED, every artifact pin required, and trainingStatus must be absent (not.required) so no document can be both trained and untrained.
